paraphrase: An early inscription on Candragiri records that Bhadrabāhu, foreseeing a twelve-year calamity in Ujjayinī, the saṅgha went to the south, and that a teacher named Prabhācandra ended his life by fasting on this hill with a single disciple in attendance.
notes: Epigraphia Carnatica II, no. 1 (c. 600 CE); Digambara tradition identifies Prabhācandra with Candragupta. Restricted theme: record only.
